checks.title: Fourteen documented default or batch save sites lack a demand seed
checks.finding: All 25 saveResult sites are represented and deliver their actual operands. Only the 11 high-level aggregate sites have any directly targeted compiled demand, all action demands. The 14 low-level/default/outer-batch save sites have no compiled demand target. Task analysis_persistence requires default saving, and mapping prose acknowledges these writes; binding the independent public saver ir_077 does not itself seed each helper invocation. A required response does not by itself preserve a separate save action.
checks.implication: The mapping needs an action obligation at each applicable save boundary, with its existing control path and opt-outs. This is an unreviewed missing-seed concern, not a deletion recommendation or a claim that this run deleted anything.

evidences.quote:
Every analysis follows three phases:

### 1. Analyze
Run API functions. Each call hits the Google APIs and returns structured data.

### 2. Auto-Save
All results automatically save as timestamped JSON files to `results/{category}/`. File naming pattern: `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS__operation__extra_info.json`

### 3. Summarize
After analysis, read the saved JSON files and create a markdown summary in `results/summaries/` with data tables, trends, and recommendations.

checks.title: Metadata wrappers lack rules for their actually demanded subfields
checks.finding: Selected mapping asks each opaque wrapper output for collection cardinality and each entry apiName, uiName and description. Each selected compute has only a whole-value output rule. There is no deterministic select/build expression inside these opaque operations that supplies those exact rules.
checks.implication: Even with a subsequently accepted review, these exact selectors need matching semantic rules or a supported exhaustive decomposition; the whole-value rule cannot stand in for them. In this run missing review is the earlier blocker. No error is inferred from scalar whole-value rules or the aggregate count of whole rules.

checks.title: Bulk save-label contract requires nonstring contents that its formula ignores
checks.finding: The selected rule demands the whole present dateRange value while its reason says nonstring contents are irrelevant. The source copies a string but emits the literal custom for every nonstring date range. A nonstring object needs its type distinction for this output, not its startDate/endDate contents.
checks.implication: This local contract overstates necessity for this consumer. Date parsing and other consumers can still require the object fields; no global deletion follows.

checks.title: Ignored filters and ordering remain recorded as a source mismatch
checks.finding: Task retains documented filter/order obligations. Mapping explicitly records that filters and orderBy are bound with no downstream request slot; sensitivity retains the actual supplied filter and sort values. Mapping only demands the actual limit inclusion test and supplied request.limit. It does not invent correct forwarding.
checks.implication: The source input problem is visible in prose, but no source review completed and the receipt contains zero source_input_findings. Absence of typed findings is unavailable review evidence, not evidence that no semantic input error exists.

checks.title: Validation truth and authentication values are distinguished
checks.finding: Mapping demands only truth of propertyId, clientEmail and privateKey for the missing-setting check, but actual email/key values for the GA4 credentials constructor. Sensitivity distinguishes fixed missing-setting messages and authentication capabilities from plaintext credentials. The compact GoogleAuth calls have zero explicit credential arguments; mapping explicitly records that limitation rather than fabricating operand slots.
checks.implication: These selected distinctions are source supported. They do not establish complete environment-to-authentication demand propagation through the summarized zero-argument helper boundaries.

checks.title: Status rows retain their original URL and selected inspection projection
checks.finding: Mapping pairs success and error rows with the current original URL, describes ordered iteration, suppresses child saves, and retains the aggregate save. Sensitivity separately records pre-attempt and post-attempt exceptions and the full acquired inspection result. The successful checkIndexStatus row uses indexStatus and verdict === PASS, excluding link/mobile/rich sections from that row without claiming they were never acquired.
checks.implication: This is source-supported consumer-specific precision. Protected-call clock/error/effect gaps remain local and explicit. It is not a proof of complete loop execution or final deletability.

checks.title: Empty bulk persistence exception is recognized downstream
checks.finding: Task does not explicitly list the empty-bulk no-save exception. Selected mapping now explicitly says the empty branch precedes filter building, acquisition and saving and demands only rowCount and rows cardinality there. analysis_persistence records the bypass as a concrete source gap.
checks.implication: The earlier concern is partly cleared at mapping, but Task wording and its declared exception set remain less precise than the source. There is no justification to invent an empty-result save or create a universal persistence blocker.

checks.title: Unused internal save returns are not promoted to required outputs
checks.finding: storage_save demands the public saver action, destination, complete supplied wrapper, and its returned path. The 25 internal save sites still have no output. analysis_summary states the documented read-and-Markdown obligation and the missing executable successor, selected file association, input projection and writer; it adds no whole-file demand merely because a read could observe the whole object.
checks.implication: The summary gap has concrete source anchors and missing relationships. It is not an excuse to discard the documented summary obligation or claim the workflow has been completed.

## Workflow Pattern

### 2. Auto-Save

### 3. Summarize
After analysis, read the saved JSON files and create a markdown summary in `results/summaries/` with data tables, trends, and recommendations.

checks.title: Latest-result substring mismatch may be a source error rather than an ambiguous purpose
checks.finding: Task retains the operation restriction but marks latest_operation_matching unresolved. Mapping precisely describes sanitized substring matching against a full path and the possible longer-name, suffix or directory collision. The API describes filtering by operation; no public text promises prefix collisions.
checks.implication: The cited conflict is concrete, but a failed implementation of a clear operation filter should be considered a semantic mismatch before treating the purpose itself as undecidable. This independent audit cannot supply the missing source-review classification.

checks.title: Some local tool contracts cite actual operands without a necessary-interface argument
checks.finding: For example, ir_451 cites only the actual saver arguments at index.ts:71-76; ir_456 cites only actual report operands at index.ts:89-94. Those lines establish invocation facts. The separate saver/report definitions and public interfaces may support required scopes, but the attached evidence alone does not show why each listed input is necessary.
checks.implication: Do not certify these requirements solely from the fact that the implementation passes them. The absent source review was the step intended to check interface sufficiency/necessity, retained/excluded scopes and request/response pairing. No acquired-field narrowing capability is established: the receipt inventory has zero acquisition projections.
